name: Sajilo v0.1.34
body:
## Notes

A new **Notes** tab for anything you want to keep: a shopping list, a number, a draft.

- Format with headings, lists and bold, and search across all your notes.
- The **ने** button switches to Nepali typing.
- Deleted notes go to a **Trash** first, with the number of days each has left. Put a note back, or delete it for good.
- Your first note is a welcome note, written in your language.

## Choose your tab bar

The tab bar now shows **Today plus up to five tabs**, and everything else sits under **More**. Pick and reorder them in **Settings › Modules › Tab bar**.

## Day plans as a to-do list

- **One line adds a plan.** Type "Meeting tomorrow 3pm" or "भोलि" and Sajilo picks out the day, time, reminder and repeat.
- **Tick plans off** day by day. A ticked plan isn't reminded.
- Edit a plan in place, and delete it with undo. Today's plans and the add line are also on the home screen.

## Notifications in one place

**Settings › Notifications** has one switch per kind of reminder, each with when it arrives.

- **Pause all reminders** for an hour, 24 hours, or until morning.
- Every reminder card has a **⋯** menu to turn that kind off.

## Shares and mutual funds

- **Every share has a price chart:** 1D (the latest session, trade by trade), 1W, 1M, 3M, 1Y and 5Y.
- **A share's page reads like ShareSansar or Merolagani:**
  - Market price (LTP)
  - Today's trading
  - The 52-week range
  - New **Fundamentals**: EPS, P/E, book value, PBV, market cap and more
  - Cash, bonus and right-share **dividends**
- **Mutual funds now have a NAV chart** going back years: 1M, 3M, 1Y and All. Closed-end funds get the market-price chart.
- A fund's page now shows **returns** (1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, since start) and its **recent NAVs** as a table.
- Labels now use the terms the portals use: Daily, Weekly and Monthly NAV, LTP, premium and discount.

## Refresh now tells you what it found

After a refresh you'll see "Updated", "Already up to date", or that a source couldn't be reached and saved data is showing. Tapping refresh again within 30 seconds says "Just checked".

## Break reminders

- **Customise > Messages** lists every line a break card can say, in English and Nepali. Reword lines, switch them off, or add your own.
- Look away, Stand up and Water can each show **one message of your own** instead.
- The countdown rings now always run from the moment the card opens.

## Fixes

- **Fuel prices** load again. NOC changed its website.
- **Crypto prices** load again from Nepal, now from CoinPaprika and Binance, with 250 coins. Coins you'd starred carry over.
- **Today** moves to the new day by itself without a restart.
- **Escape** no longer closes a pinned Sajilo.
- **Text fields** have length limits, so very long text can't be pasted in by accident.

## Linux

- **GNOME:** Sajilo's own top-bar button opens it in **one click**. It needs one log-out after updating, and Sajilo tells you when.
- **Ubuntu with the dock at the bottom:** Sajilo opens under the top bar again, not at the bottom of the screen.
- **Ubuntu 26.04:** a click outside closes Sajilo again.
- **Tiling window managers (Hyprland, sway, i3, niri):** in mini view the window is titled **"Sajilo Mini"**, so you can give the strip its own window rule. The rules are in the [Linux install guide](https://sajilo.fyi/docs/install-linux.html)

name: Sajilo v0.1.33
body:
## Important fix for Ubuntu 26.04

**If Sajilo 0.1.32 kept logging you out on Ubuntu, this fixes it.** On Ubuntu 26.04, the new top-bar icon in 0.1.32 could crash GNOME a few seconds after login, and because Sajilo starts at login, it happened every time. Sorry about that.

On GNOME, Sajilo is back to the icon it had before, with the Nepali date beside it. **Double-click** the flag to open Sajilo, or click it once and choose **Open Sajilo**. The first time you run it on GNOME, Sajilo reminds you with a notification.

**Stuck in the loop?** Press Ctrl+Alt+F3, log in, remove Sajilo (`sudo apt remove sajilo`), reboot, then install 0.1.33.

## Your rashifal every morning

Choose your sign in **Rashifal**, and Sajilo can show today's reading when you first sit down at your computer.

- It comes after a few minutes of use, not at a fixed time, so it doesn't land while you're logging in.
- Once a day, and never after noon. If you've already read it in the Rashifal tab, it doesn't come.
- Turn it on from the Rashifal tab, or in **Settings › System › Reminders › Daily rashifal**.

## Mini view

Press the new button beside the pin to shrink Sajilo into a small strip you can leave on your desktop: today's date in BS and AD, Nepal time, and one more line.

- **Click that line** to switch between the next festival or holiday, the weather, NEPSE, the dollar rate and the radio. The same choice is in **Settings › Display › Mini view**.
- It stays open and remembers where you put it. The arrows on the strip open the full view again.

## Stopwatch

A new **Stopwatch** in Tools. Tap the dial to start and pause.

- **Lap** leaves a mark on the dial. The fastest lap turns green and the slowest red.
- It keeps running when Sajilo is closed, and shows on the mini view while it runs.
- Keyboard: **Space** to start or pause, **L** for a lap, **R** to reset.

## Accent colours

**Settings › Display › Accent colour** now has nine colours, each named for something from home: **Marigold** (सयपत्री, the gold Sajilo always had), **Himalayan blue**, **Chandi** (चाँदी, for no colour at all), **Phewa**, **Ilam tea**, **Makhamali** (मखमली), **Kamal** (कमल), **Dhaka red** and **Rudraksha**. Each one works in both light and dark mode.

## Break reminders

- **Water:** see today's progress on the card, and log a glass (+250 ml) or a bottle (+500 ml).
- **Meals and bedtime:** "Going to eat" and "Going to sleep" buttons, and "Remind in 15 min" instead of 5.
- **Look away:** if the countdown ring isn't moving, the card tells you why: hands off the mouse and keyboard.
- Jokes come every few reminders, so they stay funny for longer.

## Fixes

- **Festival reminders** are on by default again.
- The stand-up and water reminders no longer arrive at the same moment and hide each other.
- Switching signs in **Rashifal** no longer makes the page jump.
- Today's date is easier to read on the calendar highlight, whichever accent colour you pick.

name: Sajilo v0.1.32
body:
## Break reminders that react to you

- **Look away:** if the countdown ring isn't moving, the card now tells you why: keep your hands off the mouse and keys, and it counts down while you look away.
- **Water:** the card shows how much you've had today. Log a glass (+250 ml) or a bottle (+500 ml) and watch the bar fill.
- **Meals and bedtime:** the buttons now say "Going to eat" and "Going to sleep", and "Remind in 15 min" instead of 5.
- Jokes now come every third reminder, so they stay funny for longer. The line after a break fits the break: drinking water gets thanked for the water, not for your back.

## The Nepal flag in your tray

- Windows and Linux now show the Nepal flag in the tray. Prefer Sajilo's own icon? Choose it in **Settings › Menu bar**.

## Linux: one click opens Sajilo

- A left click on the tray icon now opens Sajilo on KDE, Cinnamon, Xfce, MATE, Waybar, GNOME (Ubuntu, Fedora, Pop!_OS) and i3/polybar. Right-click still shows the menu.
- On Ubuntu's top bar the icon now shows without the date beside it.

## Changed

- **Festival tomorrow** reminders are now off for new installs, since most evenings have some festival. Public holidays still remind you, including festivals that are holidays. Turn festivals on in **Settings › System › Reminders**.

## Fixes

- The stand-up and water reminders came due at the same moment, and the water one never showed. Now they come one after the other.
- **Linux:** moving the mouse off Sajilo no longer closes it (Cinnamon, sway, Hyprland).
- **Linux:** the tray shows one flag, not two.
- **macOS:** no more flicker when Sajilo opens, and clicking the menu-bar date while Sajilo is open now closes it.

name: Sajilo v0.1.31
body:
## Plan reminders you won't miss

A plan with a time now reminds you by default, 10 minutes before it starts. Writing "4 PM, go to the bank" is usually because you want to be told.

- Two new options: remind 2 hours early, or a day early.
- The reminder says when the plan is ("In 10 min, at 16:20", "Tomorrow at 16:00"), then your note.
- A bell on the plan's row shows when it will remind you.

## Fixes

- **macOS 27:** left-clicking the date in the menu bar opened the small menu instead of Sajilo. It opens Sajilo again, and right-click still shows the menu.
- Reminders that arrived an hour late, or not at all, now arrive on time. Saving or deleting a plan takes effect right away, with no restart.
- A reminder missed while Sajilo was closed shows up when you open it.
- The pin at the top is now filled when it's on, so it's easier to tell.

name: Sajilo v0.1.30
body:
## Keep Sajilo open

A new pin at the top keeps Sajilo on screen while you work: leave the radio playing, watch NEPSE, or keep the converter handy.

- Pinned, it stays open when you click somewhere else, and opening a news link no longer hides it.
- Drag it anywhere by its top bar. It opens in the same place next time, even after a restart.
- Press Esc or the tray icon to put it away, and press the pin again to go back to normal.

## Linux fixes

- Clicking outside Sajilo now closes it, like any other tray app. This works on Wayland too.
- It opens next to the tray icon, including when your taskbar is at the bottom of the screen.
- Hyprland, sway and i3 users: the install guide has a one-line rule to keep it floating.

## Fixes

- "Report an issue" in About opens the right page.

name: Sajilo v0.1.29
body:
## Routine: small breaks while you work

Sajilo can now remind you to rest your eyes, stand up, drink water and stop working at the end of the day. Turn it on from the new Routine tab.

- Reminders count only the time you're actually at the computer, and five minutes away counts as a break.
- They wait during calls, fullscreen video and Do Not Disturb, then come as soon as it ends.
- Saturdays and public holidays are lighter: your eyes still get a rest, but no stand-up and no stop-work.
- Tap the glass to log water, and see your week: screen time on work days and days off, breaks taken, and your longest stretch.
- Meal and bedtime reminders are there if you want them.

## Crypto in Bazar

Bazar now tracks crypto prices next to NEPSE, forex, gold and fuel, with a chart and details for each coin.

## A fresh look across the app

- **Keeper** shows what needs doing next, with family members' late items at a glance and your documents as cards.
- **News** has one list for all sources, marks what you've read, and gives government notices their own card.
- **Weather** has a cleaner card, a range bar for each day, and place search.
- **Rashifal:** type the start of your name and it finds your sign.
- **Radio:** a proper now-playing card, with pinned stations as tiles.
- **Tools** shows today's date and your second clock right on the page, plus the emergency numbers and the full Directory of official sites and apps.
- **Bazar:** one row per metal, a quieter fuel list, and loading placeholders instead of blank screens.

## Easier to start

- New installs get a short setup card: pick language, digits and your weather place, and see today's date change as you choose.
- New installs start on 1 2 3 digits, and reminders hold off for the first few minutes.

## Fixes

- Rows that scroll sideways now work with an ordinary mouse wheel and show arrows when there's more.
- Tabs no longer flash black when you switch them on macOS.
- The first popover on macOS opens under the menu bar icon.
- On Windows the popover opens against the taskbar, with real flags and no white frame on Windows 10.
- Linux starts on Wayland without XWayland, gets an .rpm for Fedora and openSUSE, and adds `--toggle` for keyboard shortcuts.
- Plainer, everyday Nepali throughout the app.

name: Sajilo v0.1.28
body:
## Radio plays on Linux again

Starting a station froze the whole window on Arch and other rolling distros. The AppImage shipped GStreamer's core but none of its plugins, so it fell back to whatever the host had — and its older core refuses to load newer plugins, leaving the audio pipeline with no decoder and no output. The web process died with it, which is why the entire app appeared to hang rather than just the radio.

The AppImage now bundles those plugins alongside the core it already carried, so the two always match whatever distro you run it on. The release itself now fails to build if they are missing, so this cannot quietly regress.

- BBC Nepali plays on Linux. Its stream is HLS, which WebKitGTK disables unless an option is set that Sajilo never set, so it had failed on every Linux build since it was added.
- A station that produces no sound within 20 seconds now says so and lets you retry, instead of spinning forever with only Stop as a way out.

macOS and Windows were never affected — neither uses GStreamer.

name: Sajilo v0.1.27
body:
## Mutual funds, in Stocks

Stocks now has NEPSE | Mutual Funds sub-tabs.

- Every scheme's latest NAV, across SIP (open-end), Listed (closed-end) and Matured funds — fund logos, per-fund NAV dates (late ones flagged), weekly change, discount to NAV and refund NAV.
- Star the funds you hold and set up SIP payment reminders, with linked-fund setup and reminder days you control.
- Upcoming SIP payments show alongside your other reminders.
- Adjusted type sizes across the funds list and detail screens for better readability.

## Forex

- Forex moved out on its own into a Bazar tab, right after Stocks — fetch, display, and refresh all live there now.

## Weather

- No longer limited to Kathmandu, Pokhara and Lalitpur — every district headquarters and larger town is covered, 89 places in total, in English and Nepali, and it still works offline.

## Calendar

- The date page is redesigned: month, AD date and tithi, a tinted festival band, day arrows, and "Today / In N days".
- Full panchang on the date page.
- Sunday holidays are recognised.

## News

- The headline list now loads more as you scroll — no more "40 more" button.
- Nepal Government notices get a cleaner detail page: a proper source badge, tags as chips, and attachments labelled "Attachment 1", "Attachment 2" with file type and size, instead of the portal's raw upload filename.
- Fixed several icons across the app rendering heavier than intended.

## Radio

- Volume control, and station art (logos, with a fallback icon when a station has none).

## Settings

- Text size is now adjustable: small, default, or large.

## Updates

- The update button now animates to draw attention when one's available, and the tray shows "Restart to update" once it's installed and waiting.

## Fixes

- The stock range bar's track is visible again.
- Hovering a headline card now gives clear visual feedback.

name: Sajilo v0.1.26
body:
## Keeper, rebuilt

- **Documents for the whole family.** Save papers for yourself or family members, and keep more than one of the same kind: two citizenships, three bluebooks.
- **Knows what each paper does.** Citizenship and NID are kept as records. Licence, passport and insurance have expiry dates. Bluebook tax and EMIs repeat on a schedule.
- **Photos.** Add scans or phone photos by picking, dragging or pasting. Open them in a viewer to zoom, rotate or save.
- **Bluebook ↔ vehicle insurance.** A bluebook warns you when the vehicle has no policy, or when the policy runs out before tax is due.
- **Custom documents** with your own fields.
- **Reminders** for water, telephone, subscriptions, Loan EMI and more. Tick one off and a repeating reminder moves to its next date.
- **Coming up** on the Keeper home and in Today's Up next. Notifications arrive on the day and when something is overdue.

## Stocks

- NEPSE updates live every minute while the market is open, in Bazar and on the Today card.
- Gains now show in green.

## Fixes

- The back button goes back to the previous screen, including on Weather.
- Stock data is now dated by the correct trading day.

> Keeper data saved in earlier versions is reset once when you update.

name: Sajilo v0.1.0-beta.8
body: - Application got re-written from swift to tauri for cross platform support.
